extension.summary: ABC iview for Kodi with ABC Account support
extension.description: Browse and play ABC iview content in Kodi. Includes ABC Account synchronisation and configurable Kodi TV library integration for manually selected, watched or watchlisted shows.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Australian Broadcasting Corporation. ABC and iview names and artwork remain the property of their respective owners.
extension.news:
2.1.1 - Fixes Shows to include crashing when launched from the settings window - The selector no longer imports SlyGuy or the full library service without an add-on execution context - Keeps the settings window open while selecting a scope, so unsaved toggle changes are not discarded - Saves scope with Addon.getSettings().setInt(), forces a legacy flush, and verifies memory and settings.xml - Reads Library Integration directly through Kodi's Settings object - Applies and logs native settings changes immediately without restarting Kodi - Uses a version newer than the previously installed 2.1.0 so Kodi is not being downgraded
2.0.5 - Replaces the unreliable native scope list with an explicit three-option selector - Writes the selected mode with Kodi's modern getSettings().setInt() API - Forces a settings-file commit through a changing hidden legacy flush token - Verifies the value through a fresh Settings object and the on-disk profile settings.xml before reporting success - Restores Manual selection only, currently available watched episode, and My Watchlist only modes - Requests immediate library requalification and pruning after a successful change
2.0.4 - Restores Manual selection only as a library mode - Adds Add to/Remove from Kodi Library manual context-menu actions on shows - Replaces the non-persistent string list with Kodi's supported integer-backed labelled list - Uses a new setting id so invalid 2.0.3 values cannot carry forward - Keeps Shows with a currently available watched episode as the default
2.0.3 - Fixes the Shows to include setting so the selected value persists after closing settings - Stores the selection as a stable string value and reads it directly from Kodi - Adds My Watchlist only as a working library qualification mode - Changing mode triggers an automatic prune and rescan - Watchlist add/remove actions trigger prompt library reconciliation
2.0.2 - A show now qualifies only when a watched episode is still currently available on ABC iView - Expired historical watched episodes no longer import otherwise unwatched current shows - Existing shows qualified only by expired history are pruned automatically after upgrade - Temporary catalogue failures preserve an existing show until the next qualification pass
2.0.1 - Library Integration is enabled by default - Keeps the SlyGuy CommonSettings implementation - Imports a show only when at least one episode has playcount/watched state - Starting or partially watching an episode no longer imports a new show - Once qualified, imports all currently available episodes and seasons for that show - Removes generated shows that have no watched episodes - Runs a directory-scoped Kodi library clean after pruning stale generated shows - Preserves local Kodi watched shows while ABC history catches up
2.0.0 - Adds optional Kodi TV Library Integration - A show becomes followed when any episode is started or marked watched - Imports every currently available season and episode for followed shows - Keeps previously imported watched episodes as continuity anchors when they expire - Adds new seasons and episodes automatically during periodic refreshes - Uses STRM and local NFO files so library items launch the ABC iView add-on - Synchronises Kodi library watched, unwatched and resume states with ABC - Imports existing linked-account viewing history when Library Integration is enabled - Adds automatic local Kodi source configuration with scoped library scans - Retains targeted diagnostics under IVIEW200LIB
1.1.5 - Production release of the watched-state race fix from 1.1.4.2 - Keeps Kodi's selected episode state authoritative while iView catches up - Adds an optional targeted diagnostic logging setting - Diagnostics also activate automatically with Kodi global debug logging - Redacts account credentials from diagnostic output - Suppresses duplicate writes when two detectors catch the same action - Retains single-episode queued writes and retry protection
1.1.4.2 - Fixes the race where Kodi's automatic folder rebuild restored stale iView state - Captures the selected episode and baseline while the context menu is open - Uses the post-toggle folder rebuild as the reliable watched-action signal - Keeps Kodi's local playcount authoritative until iView reports the same state - Queues only the selected episode and retries failed iView writes - Never scans or changes an entire season - Never refreshes Kodi after a watched-state write failure
1.1.4.1 diagnostic - Exact 1.1.4 behaviour with diagnostic logging only - Logs service invocation, Kodi OnUpdate payloads, selected playcount, 1.1.4 inference decisions, ABC history reads and ABC writes
1.1.4 - Fixed Kodi Mark unwatched syncing when the selected plugin item briefly disappears - Uses VideoLibrary.OnUpdate playcount and a short selected-item grace period
1.1.3 - Kodi's built-in Mark watched and Mark unwatched actions now sync to ABC iview - Removed the duplicate ABC-specific watched context actions - ABC episode identifiers are retained on playable item URLs for watched syncing
1.1.2 - Fixed ABC watched and progress writes to use the current PATCH history API - Added the required history query values, including done state - Renamed ABC sync context actions to distinguish them from Kodi-only actions
1.1.1 - Fixed ABC account token renewal after access-token expiry - Authenticated ABC requests now retry once after HTTP 401
1.1.0 - Added two-way watched-status and resume-progress sync with ABC accounts - Added Mark watched and Mark unwatched episode context-menu actions - Episodes watched on ABC are displayed as watched in Kodi
1.0.2 - Added Add to My Watchlist and Remove from My Watchlist context-menu actions - Added five-minute watchlist-state caching with immediate refresh after changes - Uses the current authenticated ABC Seesaw watchlist API
1.0.1 - Added ABC Account QR-code device linking - Added My Watchlist and Continue Watching - Added live ABC channels - Updated catalogue browsing and playback - Packaged under the unique plugin.video.abc_iviewjc add-on ID
